description:
Hi! We are Galaxy Rangers, a passionate high school team tackling the "Earth Analogs for Moon & Mars Bases" challenge. We bring strong skills in Coding, Web Development, Games, and Graphic Design to build an interactive 3D web/game platform comparing Earth and planetary data.

We're looking for teammates with Earth/Planetary Science, Data Analysis, or Storytelling skills to help analyze NASA datasets and craft our pitch. Let's innovate and explore space together!
